builder_plan.scenario: An agent reads external documents or tool responses that may contain malicious instructions.
builder_plan.change: Replay attacks and legitimate lookalikes in an isolated copy of your agent workflow.
builder_plan.baseline: Your existing checks with the same tasks, permissions, and tool responses.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Successful attacks missed, legitimate actions blocked, detection delay, and review cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: Fit-LRP: Fitting Linear Relaxations to Polytopes for Neural Network Verification over Non-Convex Regions
summary: Fit-LRP replaces loose axis-aligned box relaxations in the final optimization step of LiRPA/alpha,beta-CROWN verification with exact affine bounds over unions of polytopes, solved as a sequence of small low-dimensional linear programs. The cost is added LP-solving per verification node and the need to formulate specifications as explicit polyhedral regions, with reported speedups of up to 15x in worst-case verification time and large reductions in branching. It can fail when specifications are not naturally polyhedral, when LP overhead outweighs pruning gains on easy instances, or when the surrounding BaB pipeline and reachability tooling are not already in place.
rationale: This is formal neural network verification for cyber-physical systems and Lyapunov certificates, which is outside the production inference and deployment scope of an engineer adopting practical techniques on constrained infrastructure.
technique: Polytope-fitted linear relaxation for NN verification

claims.statement: Fit-LRP replaces loose axis-aligned box relaxations in the final optimization step of LiRPA/alpha,beta-CROWN verification with exact affine bounds over unions of polytopes, solved as a sequence of small low-dimensional linear programs. The cost is added LP-solving per verification node and the need to formulate specifications as explicit polyhedral regions, with reported speedups of up to 15x in worst-case verification time and large reductions in branching. It can fail when specifications are not naturally polyhedral, when LP overhead outweighs pruning gains on easy instances, or when the surrounding BaB pipeline and reachability tooling are not already in place.

Fit-LRP reduces branching on the hardest region by 47x, cuts worst-case verification time by 15x, and with region-wise partitioning verifies on a single CPU 6.1x faster than alpha,beta-CROWN on a GPU.
